item.title: Undo close tab in Eclipse
item.description: I don't know about you, but I love the Firefox's undo-close-tab feature (Ctrl+Shift+T). If you use Eclipse you might be glad to know you can undo the close-tab action in Eclipse as well. You can do that both using your mouse by clicking on the yellow left arrow you can see in the Eclipse toolbar…
